title: Booking API, languages, security, API v3 and outbound
text: Booking rules and branches, Arabic texts, who is calling, REST v3 with OAuth and what we send to the broker.

title: Booking API: the branches this broker may use, their opening hours and holidays, and the booking rules.
text: Minimum driver age, how far ahead, the longest rental, fees, cancellation and no-shows.

title: When you change or cancel a broker booking, the broker is told automatically. Failed updates are retried and shown in red at the top.
Languages: Arabic names and texts for brokers that ask in Arabic.
Security: every address that called with this broker’s code, failed sign-ins, and addresses locked after too many wrong keys.
text: You can also limit the broker to its own IP addresses and require signed requests.

title: API v3: for brokers that prefer REST/JSON. Each gets an OAuth client with exactly the permissions it needs, and webhook notifications.
Outbound: for brokers that want us to send to them — rate files, availability updates and booking notifications to their own system.
